benchmark_metadata.authoring_process: Manually authored and verified against the 184 Tier-A chunks in catalog.db without LLM assistance
benchmark_metadata.disclaimer: This is a development retrieval benchmark for evaluating baseline recall and MRR; it is not a held-out test split.

queries.query: What is the application fee for submitting an RTI request under the 2012 rules?
queries.rationale: Rule 3 of RTI Rules 2012 specifies the application fee of Rupees ten.

queries.query: Are Below Poverty Line (BPL) applicants exempt from paying RTI fees?
queries.rationale: Rule 5 of RTI Rules 2012 specifies that no fee under rule 3 and rule 4 shall be charged from persons below the poverty line.

queries.query: What are the allowed payment modes for RTI fees under the rules?
queries.rationale: Rule 6 lists payment modes including cash, demand draft, banker's cheque, and postal order.

queries.query: What fee is charged per page for providing information in A4 size under RTI Rules?
queries.rationale: Rule 4(a) provides for rupees two for each page in A-3 or A-4 size paper.

queries.query: What are the mandatory documents to be accompanied with an appeal to the Commission under Rule 8?
queries.rationale: Rule 8 specifies appeal accompaniment documents including copies of application, CPIO reply, and first appeal order.

queries.query: On what grounds may an appeal be returned to the appellant under Rule 9?
queries.rationale: Rule 9 governs the return of appeal if it does not comply with Rule 8.

queries.query: Can the Central Information Commission hear an appeal through video conferencing?
queries.rationale: Rule 11 allows deciding appeals through video conferencing or audio-video electronic means.

queries.query: What is the time limit for a Public Information Officer to provide information concerning life or liberty?
queries.rationale: Section 7(1) proviso mandates that information concerning life or liberty shall be provided within forty-eight hours.

queries.query: How many days does a PIO have to dispose of a standard RTI request under Section 7?
queries.rationale: Section 7(1) specifies 30 days from receipt of the request.

queries.query: Within how many days must an RTI application be transferred to another public authority under Section 6(3)?
queries.rationale: Section 6(3) proviso states transfer shall be made as soon as practicable but in no case later than five days.

queries.query: What categories of information are exempt from disclosure under Section 8 of the RTI Act?
queries.rationale: Section 8(1) enumerates exemptions including sovereignty, security, contempt of court, commercial confidence, and privacy.

queries.query: What penalty can the Information Commission impose on a CPIO under Section 20?
queries.rationale: Section 20(1) authorizes penalty of two hundred and fifty rupees each day till application is received, up to twenty-five thousand rupees.

queries.query: What is the time limit for filing a first appeal under Section 19 of the RTI Act?
queries.rationale: Section 19(1) specifies that appeal may be filed within thirty days from expiry of period or receipt of decision.

queries.query: What is the definition of public authority under Section 2(h) of the RTI Act?
queries.rationale: Section 2(h) defines public authority established or constituted by Constitution, Parliament, State legislature, or appropriate Government.

queries.query: What suo motu proactive disclosures are required of public authorities under Section 4(1)(b)?
queries.rationale: Section 4(1)(b) lists 17 manual items that every public authority must publish within 120 days of enactment.

queries.query: Can partial access to record be granted under the doctrine of severability in Section 10?
queries.rationale: Section 10(1) allows access to that part of the record which does not contain exempt information.

queries.query: What is the annual financial assistance provided to eligible farmer families under PM-KISAN?
queries.rationale: Section 2 of PM-KISAN guidelines provides income support of Rs. 6000/- per year in three 4-monthly installments of Rs. 2000/- each.

queries.query: How is a landholder farmer family defined in the PM-KISAN guidelines?
queries.rationale: Section 3 defines farmer family as consisting of husband, wife and minor children who own cultivable land.

queries.query: Are serving or retired government employees excluded from PM-KISAN benefits?
queries.rationale: Section 4.1(d) excludes serving or retired officers and employees of central/state government departments, excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D.

queries.query: Are income tax payers eligible for the PM-KISAN scheme?
queries.rationale: Section 4.1(e) explicitly excludes all persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year.

queries.query: What is the cut-off date for determination of land ownership eligibility under PM-KISAN?
queries.rationale: Section 5.2 establishes 01.02.2019 as the cut-off date for determination of eligibility of beneficiaries.

queries.query: Is Aadhaar mandatory for release of installments under the PM-KISAN scheme?
queries.rationale: Section 6 of PM-KISAN guidelines provides that Aadhaar number is mandatory for transfer of benefit.

queries.query: What percentage of PM-KISAN beneficiaries must undergo physical verification annually?
queries.rationale: Section 9 mandates physical verification of 5% of the total beneficiaries every year.

queries.query: What core categories of beneficiaries are targeted under the AB PM-JAY scheme?
queries.rationale: Section 1 describes targeting occupational categories of urban workers and deprivation criteria in rural households based on SECC 2011.

queries.query: What identity document is primarily preferred for beneficiary verification in PM-JAY?
queries.rationale: Section 4 establishes Aadhaar as the preferred identity document for verifying an individual beneficiary.

queries.query: What alternative identity documents are accepted if Aadhaar is not available in PM-JAY?
queries.rationale: Section 4 lists alternative government photo identity cards like Ration Card, Voter ID, Driving License, MGNREGA job card.

queries.query: What parameters can be used to search for a beneficiary in the PM-JAY database?
queries.rationale: Section 5 details database search options: Name, Location, Ration Card, RSBY URN, Mobile Number, or HHID.

queries.query: Who is responsible for the final approval of beneficiary identification and e-card issuance under PM-JAY?
queries.rationale: Section 8 specifies that approval of beneficiary identification is conducted by the Insurance Company or Trust.

queries.query: What is the role of the Pradhan Mantri Arogya Mitra (PMAM) in beneficiary identification?
queries.rationale: Section 2 outlines PMAM kiosk operations at empanelled healthcare providers to identify beneficiaries and collect documents.

queries.query: What is the procedure for linking a family member to an existing PM-JAY family unit?
queries.rationale: Section 7 details linking family identification documents (such as ration card) to the SECC PM-JAY family record.

queries.query: What are the GST tax slabs and applicable rates for restaurant services?
queries.rationale: GST tax slabs are governed by GST Council enactments, which are outside the 4 Tier-A seed documents.

queries.query: What is the maximum traffic fine for riding a motorcycle without a helmet under the Motor Vehicles Act?
queries.rationale: Motor vehicle penalties are governed by Motor Vehicles Act 1988/2019, absent from the seed corpus.

queries.query: How much subsidy is provided under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Urban for EWS houses?
queries.rationale: PMAY Urban guidelines are not part of the Tier-A seed corpus.

queries.query: What are the rules and lock-in period for withdrawing funds from an Employee Provident Fund (EPF) account?
queries.rationale: EPFO regulations are not in the approved Tier-A corpus.

queries.query: What is the current interest rate for Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana small savings accounts?
queries.rationale: Sukanya Samriddhi scheme rules and notifications are not in the Tier-A corpus.

queries.query: How many days of guaranteed wage employment are provided under MGNREGA per household?
queries.rationale: MGNREGA 2005 Act is not part of the four ingested Tier-A documents.

queries.query: सूचना का अधिकार नियमावली 2012 के तहत आवेदन शुल्क कितना है?
queries.rationale: Rule 3 of RTI Rules 2012 defines the application fee of ten rupees.

queries.query: क्या गरीबी रेखा से नीचे (BPL) के नागरिकों को आरटीआई शुल्क में छूट मिलती है?
queries.rationale: Rule 5 provides exemption from payment of fee for persons living below poverty line.

queries.query: आरटीआई नियमों के अनुसार शुल्क भुगतान के कौन-कौन से तरीके मान्य हैं?
queries.rationale: Rule 6 lists payment methods: cash, demand draft, banker's cheque, postal order.

queries.query: सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम की धारा 7 के तहत जीवन और स्वतंत्रता से जुड़ी जानकारी कितने समय में देनी होती है?
queries.rationale: Section 7(1) proviso mandates 48 hours for life and liberty related information.

queries.query: जन सूचना अधिकारी (PIO) को आरटीआई आवेदन का निपटारा कितने दिनों में करना होता है?
queries.rationale: Section 7(1) specifies 30 days for disposal.

queries.query: यदि आवेदन किसी अन्य लोक प्राधिकरण से संबंधित हो तो धारा 6(3) के तहत कितने दिनों में स्थानांतरित किया जाना चाहिए?
queries.rationale: Section 6(3) proviso mandates transfer within 5 days.

queries.query: सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम की धारा 8 के तहत कौन सी सूचनाएं प्रकट करने से छूट प्राप्त हैं?
queries.rationale: Section 8 lists exemptions from disclosure of information.

queries.query: सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम की धारा 20 के तहत पीआईओ पर कितना जुर्माना लगाया जा सकता है?
queries.rationale: Section 20(1) prescribes penalty of Rs 250 per day up to Rs 25,000.

queries.query: धारा 19 के अंतर्गत प्रथम अपील कितने दिनों के भीतर दायर की जा सकती है?
queries.rationale: Section 19(1) provides 30 days time limit for first appeal.

queries.query: पीएम-किसान योजना के तहत किसान परिवार को प्रति वर्ष कितनी वित्तीय सहायता दी जाती है?
queries.rationale: Section 2 outlines income support of Rs. 6000 per year in 3 installments of Rs. 2000.

queries.query: पीएम-किसान योजना के अनुसार किसान परिवार की क्या परिभाषा है?
queries.rationale: Section 3 defines farmer family as husband, wife and minor children owning cultivable land.

queries.query: क्या आयकर दाता किसान पीएम-किसान सम्मान निधि के पात्र हैं?
queries.rationale: Section 4.1(e) explicitly excludes all persons who paid income tax in last assessment year.

queries.query: पीएम-किसान योजना में भूमि स्वामित्व पात्रता की कट-ऑफ तारीख क्या है?
queries.rationale: Section 5.2 establishes 01.02.2019 as the cut-off date.

queries.query: पीएम-किसान योजना में क्या आधार कार्ड होना अनिवार्य है?
queries.rationale: Section 6 establishes mandatory Aadhaar requirement for installment transfer.

queries.query: आयुष्मान भारत पीएम-जय योजना के तहत लाभार्थी की पहचान के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा पहचान पत्र मान्य है?
queries.rationale: Section 4 gives primary preference to Aadhaar for beneficiary verification.

queries.query: आयुष्मान भारत डेटाबेस में लाभार्थी को खोजने के लिए कौन-कौन से विवरण उपयोग किए जा सकते हैं?
queries.rationale: Section 5 lists search parameters including Name, Ration Card, RSBY URN, HHID.

queries.query: आयुष्मान भारत पीएम-जय में ई-कार्ड जारी करने और सत्यापन की अंतिम मंजूरी किसके द्वारा दी जाती है?
queries.rationale: Section 8 establishes approval by Insurance Company or Trust.

queries.query: अस्पताल में प्रधानमंत्री आरोग्य मित्र की क्या भूमिका होती है?
queries.rationale: Section 2 outlines Arogya Mitra kiosk functions for patient verification and document upload.

queries.query: ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस बनवाने के लिए ऑनलाइन आवेदन शुल्क कितना है?
queries.rationale: Driving license rules fall under Motor Vehicle rules, not in the Tier-A corpus.

queries.query: भारतीय दंड संहिता में हत्या के अपराध के लिए क्या सजा निर्धारित है?
queries.rationale: Criminal law (IPC/BNS) is outside the Tier-A administrative law corpus.

queries.query: पासपोर्ट नवीनीकरण के लिए पुलिस सत्यापन में कितने दिन लगते हैं?
queries.rationale: Passports Act rules are not in the approved Tier-A corpus.

queries.query: वित्तीय वर्ष 2024-25 के लिए नई कर व्यवस्था में आयकर स्लैब क्या हैं?
queries.rationale: Income tax slabs and Finance Act provisions are outside the seed corpus.

queries.query: मनरेगा योजना के अंतर्गत मजदूरी का भुगतान कितने दिनों में होना चाहिए?
queries.rationale: MGNREGA operational rules are outside the seed corpus.

queries.query: आधार कार्ड में जन्मतिथि बदलने के लिए कौन से दस्तावेज मान्य हैं?
queries.rationale: UIDAI enrollment regulations are not included in the Tier-A seed documents.
